notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.42 — Unified Recruitment Pipeline for PC and laptop. Home now focuses on recruitment actions, people waiting, calls and inductions. The sidebar is simplified to Home, Call Mode, Pipeline and Calendar (Settings remains). Proceeding after induction enters the pipeline; Contract sent is now a separate manual tick rather than automatically assumed. Existing signed contracts are recognised. Each proceeding candidate shows a name and green progress bar. Expand to tick contract sent/signed, check Cortex onboarding started and readiness, copy the current AmiGO online training pack with a Cortex username shortcut, record reported/verified training, flexible one- or two-day ridealongs, van allocation and first working shift. The next required action and Dropbox/Cortex links appear in the expanded card. No 14/15 or 15/15 entry required. Call Mode and induction booking are retained; the Notes/history area is collapsible for a cleaner calling view. Completing all steps asks Hired? Yes/No. No requires a reason. Only an explicit confirmation attempts an official MBL Hired or Not Hired update; the status is read back from MBL, with safe queued retry/conflict handling. Existing MBL candidate data, training pack copy, induction functions and contract check shortcuts remain. Android apps are unchanged. IMPORTANT: Checklist ticks and ridealong dates currently save per Windows device. Hiring outcomes sync with official MBL, but the private checklist data does not yet synchronise between PC and laptop. Shared checklist storage is planned for the next stage.
